# Owned CI test support

GitFixture is a non-TestCase lifecycle/data helper for the real source-identity and fixed-suite tests. setup_repository(files), write(name,data), git(*argv), commit(), restore() and close() preserve the existing consumers. It creates only private local disposable repositories, copies bytes/text without mutating input, restores tracked bytes and removes owned untracked files. It owns initialization failure cleanup and propagates native errors/timeouts. No remote workflow or production source-identity API is provided.

Helper writes require canonical relative ASCII paths, reject traversal/Git metadata/symlink ancestors or targets/hardlinks/directory targets and reject non-bytes/text values before writing. Git operations check the owned root and reject root/.git aliases. Subprocesses use /usr/bin/git, a fresh allowlisted environment, no system/global Git config, no template hooks and disabled hooks/fsmonitor; ambient Git repository/index/object/config/template redirection is not inherited. This is a controlled test helper, not a sandbox against adversarial Python callers or arbitrary local repository configuration.

assert_receipt_workflow(test,text,exact_paths,exact_command,evidence_name) checks this project's fixed receipt-workflow format: exact paths, PR/main-push head routing, pins, read-only/no persisted credentials, timeout, strict shell and fresh success-only receipt. It is a text assertion, not a general YAML policy engine or workflow runner. Own positive/negative text controls use synthetic input; each real consumer still checks its actual workflow in its own suite.

The four owned paths are this document, ci_test_support.py, test_ci_test_support.py and workflows/ci-test-support.yml under .github. The independent PR/main-push workflow checks out the actual event head and runs isolated fixed standard unittest without source_identity, upper or SPEC imports. Its fixed launcher binds native Git head/tree/modes/blobs/SHA-256 before/after, rejects dirty/missing/aliases/modes/hidden bytes, requires exact six IDs and complete all-passing execution with no skips/xfail/xpass, and checks actual support/test imports. Fresh private evidence retains the raw unittest result and fixed source records, not the later canonical receipt schema. Only those two successful files are uploaded; private synthetic fixtures and failing diagnostics are not.

Own controls cover lifecycle/restore/clean/close, copied input, unsafe writes with an unchanged owned sentinel, setup cleanup and native errors, two-fixture ambient Git isolation, full workflow assertion positives/negatives, real bootstrap outcome/inventory/import/mutation rejection and source identity faults. Native operations time out at 15 seconds and the workflow at five minutes. This fixed launcher is not a generic selector, capture service or adversarial sandbox. Verified Actions pins are inherited from the independently checked official commit records.

Adoption is support → source identity → fixed owner without SPEC → separate original strict-JSON leaf with actual owner+core. Each complete responsibility needs its own measured budget, registration, independent final-head review, actual PR CI, existing required checks and postmerge main-push verification. Later consumers record complete own files plus actual executable dependency files; each dependency's separate own tests/docs/workflow remains independently adopted and checked. Local fixture runs are not GitHub runs, and no branch protections or permissions change.
